note: Required measurement matrix for IMPROVE-TODO B01. This file describes WHAT must be measured (axes, repetitions, hardware classes) - it contains no results. Every entry starts as untested and may only be marked tested with a real measurement on that hardware.

audio.note: The full axis product is 36 workloads; the default profile is the fast smoke measurement.

llm.note: Fixed seeds per brief. Cold start and warm start are reported separately; model switches are part of the run.

multi_gpu: single GPU of the same total
hardware.note: Mocked detection tests the decisions; it never replaces a real measurement. Hardware that does not exist on the measuring machine stays untested.

metrics: device_vram_free_bytes and device_vram_total_bytes per visible GPU
model identity, context, chunk size and sampler values (LLM runs)
honesty_rules: torch.cuda allocated/reserved alone does not account for llama.cpp or aimdo allocations
no full private prompts or audio content in standard telemetry
CUDA synchronisation happens at benchmark boundaries only, never in the normal hot path
unmeasured hardware is reported as untested, never as a result
